We are covering the 2026 Milano Winter Olympics for the Norwegian broadcast team. Right now the alert system in our workspace is configured for the Korean team by default, but we need it switched over to Norway (🇳🇴) before the games start.

Please reconfigure the Olympic alert system so that:
1. It tracks Norway instead of Korea, with the correct Norwegian flag.
2. The broadcast links are updated to Norwegian sports media (e.g., NRK Sport at https://nrk.no/sport and/or Viaplay at https://viaplay.no/sport) — the Korean links must be removed.
3. All Korean athlete events are replaced with at least two real Norwegian Olympic events for 2026 (Biathlon is a must — Johannes Boe is our star). Use realistic dates in February 2026 and include the athlete names.
4. Make sure the system's schedule management commands still work correctly after your changes.

The skill files are already present in the workspace under `skills/olympic-alert/`. Use them as-is.
